name: AI Evidence Check
author: Knotarium
description: Fact-checks a claim against reference sources and routes by the verdict — the AI Verify node in one run. The claim and the sources are checked claim-by-claim; the verdict (verified / unsupported / contradicted / uncertain) is decided by deterministic code over the model's structured findings, not by a second 'does this look right?' prompt. The bundled sample claim contradicts the sources, so a fresh run lands on the 'contradicted' branch. Requires an AI provider under Settings → AI Provider.
